declaration.declared_before: any E0 feature, label, baseline, bucket, hypothesis result or bootstrap was computed
declaration.promotion_claim: PASS means only that a formal Strategy E research track is worth opening. It is not an alpha approval, not a trading rule and not an execution claim.
declaration.question: Using only information observable up to the regular-session close, can the probability and expected value of the next session's open (or the first minutes after it) be raised meaningfully above the unconditional base rate?

minute_cohorts.M1_DEEP: the 30 MINUTE_UNIVERSE_V1 symbols over the full grid (raw pages plus the legacy normalized parquet)
minute_cohorts.M2_BROAD: the symbols collected by historical_v2 over the recent scope window 2026-04-20..2026-09-16

frozen_inputs.no_new_collection: E0 issues no provider API call. It reads only files that already exist.

universe.membership: ticker is in the latest CS reference snapshot dated on or before D
universe.security_type: CS only; ETF, fund, warrant, unit and test symbols are excluded by the CS reference itself
universe.dollar_volume_window: median of close*volume over the 20 sessions [D-20, D-1], strictly before D, so the liquidity filter cannot select on D's own volume spike
universe.corporate_action_exclusion: ca_excluded when a split executes in (D, D+1]; such rows are dropped from every E0 statistic and counted separately
universe.split_basis: prices are split-normalized with F(t), the cumulative price factor of splits executed on or before t; volume is v/F; dollar volume needs no adjustment

minute_labels.close_to_next_1m: close of the 09:30 ET bar of D+1 / close(D) - 1
minute_labels.close_to_next_5m: close of the 09:34 ET bar of D+1 / close(D) - 1
minute_labels.close_to_next_15m: close of the 09:44 ET bar of D+1 / close(D) - 1

labels.execution_limitation: the official consolidated open is not an executable fill; E0 measures the official print only and makes no slippage, spread, auction or capacity claim

daily_features.clv: (close - low) / (high - low); undefined when high == low, such rows are kept in the baseline and dropped from CLV buckets and from any hypothesis that reads CLV
daily_features.rvol: v(D)/F(D) divided by the median of v/F over [D-20, D-1]; undefined when that median is 0
daily_features.relative_strength_5d: momentum_5d - SPY momentum_5d over the same 5 sessions
daily_features.availability: every feature reads sessions <= D only

minute_features.return_1530_to_close: close of the 15:59 bar / open of the 15:30 bar - 1
minute_features.return_1545_to_close: close of the 15:59 bar / open of the 15:45 bar - 1
minute_features.close_to_day_high: close(D) / max(high) over the regular session - 1
minute_features.availability: no bar with a start at or after 16:00 ET of D enters any feature

buckets.note: fixed edges declared before any result was seen; no bucket edge is tuned to an outcome

hypotheses.thresholds_come_from: the declared bucket edges only; no optimizer, no sweep, no search over thresholds

robustness.quarterly: calendar quarters of D; every quarter reported with N, mean, median, win rate and mean lift
symbol_concentration: share of total excess return contributed by the top 5 tickers
result after removing the top 5 contributing tickers

bootstrap.unit: session (block bootstrap over D, so rows of one session move together)
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 / 97.5 of the mean lift and of the median lift

gate.evaluated_on: the best declared daily hypothesis by N-weighted evidence, and separately on each minute hypothesis

pass_requires_all.downside_metric: P(overnight_return <= -0.05) of the candidate divided by the same probability of the baseline

gate.inconclusive_requires: bootstrap mean lift CI low > 0 and at least one pass_requires_all item failed
gate.no_post_hoc_edit: if the declared hypotheses fail, the verdict is FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE. Rules are not edited to produce a PASS; a new question needs a new declaration file.

artifacts.run_id: e0-<12 hex of the run identity digest>
